限大學部(大四下畢業者亦不可申請) 
Have completed at least two Japanese language courses (or courses equivalent to JLPT 
N3~2) and one Japanese culture or related course. Maintain a cumulative GPA of 2.5 or 
higher (on a 4-point scale) for all undergraduate courses at the time of the application 
deadline.

必須先經過第一階段校內申請通過，且經過國際處向姐妹校提名後，才有資格進行第
二階段(姊妹校)申請。 
・Application Form 
・Essay theme & requirements 
・Two separate Letter of Recommendation forms (校內初選請直接用姊妹校格式) 
・Certificate of Health Form 
Please read each form carefully and fill them out as necessary.  
A form for each Letter of Recommendation (one academic advisor; one Japanese instructor OR other 
faculty member closely associated with you) should be handed to the corresponding faculty after 
obtaining permission as necessary. 
As per the application guidelines, please obtain and submit the following in addition to the forms 
listed above:  
・Official transcript(s) of undergraduate course work. 
If you have any questions regarding any of the necessary forms listed above, please consult with your 
academic advisor, the staff member at your institution's international center, etc. as necessary.
